learningObjectives: Explain the role of middleware in a backend application.
Organize backend code into maintainable architectural layers.

activities.title: Backend Layer Map

content.concept: A layered backend separates responsibilities such as routing, controllers, business logic, data access, and infrastructure so each part has a focused role.

activities.title: Middleware Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the important parts of an Express middleware function.

content.concept: Express middleware receives a request, response, and next function. It can inspect or modify the request, perform checks, and call next() to continue processing.

activities.instruction: Arrange the stages of a typical protected API request.

content.concept: Backend requests can pass through middleware such as logging, authentication, and validation before reaching a route handler and producing a response.
